Όταν ένας πελάτης σου λέει «δεν μου εμφα: When a client tells you "my balance isn't showing correctly", the description is rarely enough. The "Sign in as" action in the Users list logs you into the app as that user, showing you exactly the same screen they see.

Κανείς δεν μπορεί να μπει ως άλλος platf: Nobody can sign in as another platform admin — this prevents privilege escalation.
Ό,τι κάνεις όσο είσαι μέσα καταγράφεται: Anything you do while inside is recorded under that user's name. Use it for diagnosis, not to make changes on their behalf.
το impersonation σου δίνει πρόσβαση σε π: impersonation gives you access to employees' personal data (leave, reasons for sick leave). Use it only when there is a genuine support request, and tell the client the capability exists.
Κάθε είσοδος και έξοδος από impersonatio: Every entry into and exit from impersonation is logged automatically. In the "Impersonation History" menu you see which platform admin signed in as which user, in which company, and when the session started and ended.
Οι εγγραφές που δείχνουν \"— σε εξέλιξη: Entries showing "— in progress —" in the "Ended" column are sessions active right now.
Ο πίνακας είναι αποκλειστικά για ανάγνωσ: The table is strictly read-only — it cannot be deleted or edited from the UI. That is the point: an audit trail somebody can alter is worthless if you ever need to prove to a client who saw their data and when.
Η πρόσβαση στο /platform ελέγχεται από έ: Access to /platform is controlled by a separate flag on the user ("Platform Admin"), entirely independent of the roles held inside companies.
Ένας admin εταιρείας ΔΕΝ βλέπει το Platf: A company admin does NOT see the Platform panel.
Ένας platform admin ΔΕΝ αποκτά αυτόματα: A platform admin does NOT automatically gain an admin role in any company.
Ο λόγος που είναι ξεχωριστό: οι ρόλοι Ad: Why it is separate: the Admin/Employee roles are stored per company, so they could in theory be assigned by a company administrator. Access to the platform must never depend on something a client can change.
Το flag ενεργοποιείται μόνο τεχνικά, απε: The flag is enabled only technically, directly in the database — there is deliberately no button in the UI. Keep it on a very small number of trusted accounts.
Αν χρειαστεί να δώσεις σε συγκεκριμένο υ: If you need to give a specific employee a different number of days than the automatic calculation produces (e.g. extra days as a bonus, or a correction), open that user from the "Users" menu.
Στο κάτω μέρος της σελίδας επεξεργασίας,: At the bottom of the edit page, below their details, is the "Manual Balance Overrides" section. Use "Add Override" to enter a leave type, a year, and the number of days you want.
η τιμή αυτή αντικαθιστά ΠΛΗΡΩΣ τον αυτόμ: this value REPLACES the automatic calculation entirely for that user, leave type and year — it is not added to it. If someone is entitled to 22 days and you enter 5, they will have 5 in total, not 27.
Η ρύθμιση αφορά ένα μόνο έτος. Την επόμε: An override applies to a single year. The next year the calculation automatically reverts to normal, unless you enter a new one.
Only one column can be the starting one.

Μετακίνησε πρώτα τις εργασίες της σε άλλ: Move its tasks to another column first.
